an6.80:1.1: LXXX. Chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirass'eva mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesu. Katamehi chahi? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ālokabahulo ca hoti, yogabahulo ca hoti, vedabahulo ca hoti, asantuṭṭhibahulo ca, anikkhittadhuro ca kusalesu dhammesu, uttariñ ca patāreti. Imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirass'eva mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesū ti.
